items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: The name 'Gianni' appears only as a repetitive stutter/fragment ('Gianni Gianni...') within a stream of consciousness about a music teacher and a drummer, with no explicit narrative connection or interaction described between Hypolite Charles and a person named Gianni.

ctx.x: You were. You didn't want me to leave. Oh, I can see. I met his friends and I think. 35 years since I've seen that boy. Oh, my.

That's why I tell you by being, you see that's one thing we all have to always do. Never think you're more than anybody or never throw nobody down regardless of their communication. Oh, yeah. That's their business. People live to suit themselves. You ain't got nothing to do with that. That's as sure as the truth. You see? That's why Louis can tell you, every one of those musicians in the city of New Orleans loved me. Because no matter if they couldn't play home sweet home brass, I was with them. I'm telling you.…
